scheme_name: Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana
description:
The Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Uttar Pradesh. 

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2021. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide free educational materials to the children of construction workers. 

The initiative aims to ensure that children from economically weaker sections receive the necessary educational support to pursue their studies without financial hindrances. 

The scheme specifically targets children of registered construction workers under the Building and Other Construction Workers Act 1996. 

The government aims to benefit approximately 1.5 million children through this initiative. 

Each eligible child is entitled to receive a financial assistance amount of ₹1,000 per academic year. 

This amount is intended to cover the costs of school uniforms and educational materials such as books and stationery. 

The assistance is aimed at children studying in classes 1 to 8 in government and recognized private schools. 

To be eligible for this scheme, the applicant must be a child of a registered construction worker. 

The construction worker must be registered with the Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The age limit for the children eligible under this scheme is between 6 to 14 years. 

There is no specific income criterion mentioned for the construction workers to avail of this scheme. 

However, the construction worker must have a valid registration number with the welfare board. 

To apply for the benefits under this scheme, the applicant must follow a specific process. 

The first step is to visit the official website of the Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The applicant must fill out the application form available on the website. 

The application form requires details such as the name of the construction worker, registration number, and details of the child. 

The applicant must also provide proof of the child's age, such as a birth certificate or school admission form. 

Additionally, the applicant must submit a copy of the construction worker's registration certificate. 

Once the application form is completed, it must be submitted online through the official portal. 

The application will then be processed by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of the financial assistance is typically done directly to the bank account of the construction worker. 

The government aims to complete the processing of applications within 30 days of submission. 

The financial assistance is disbursed at the beginning of the academic year. 

This ensures that families receive the necessary funds before the school year starts. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Uttar Pradesh. 

For any inquiries or assistance regarding the scheme, individuals can contact the board through their official helpline. 

The helpline number is 1800 180 5151. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to support the welfare of construction workers and their families. 

The government recognizes the challenges faced by construction workers, particularly in providing education for their children. 

This scheme is a step towards ensuring that children from these families have access to quality education. 

The initiative also aims to reduce dropout rates among children of construction workers. 

By providing financial assistance for educational materials, the government hopes to encourage these children to continue their studies. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders, including labor unions and educational institutions. 

Many believe that such initiatives are crucial for the socio-economic upliftment of marginalized communities. 

The government plans to monitor the implementation of the scheme closely. 

Regular audits and assessments will be conducted to ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The scheme also aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations, particularly in promoting quality education. 

The government is committed to expanding the reach of this scheme in the coming years. 

There are plans to increase the financial assistance amount based on inflation and rising educational costs. 

This will ensure that the support provided remains relevant and sufficient for the needs of the beneficiaries. 

The success of this scheme could serve as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

The government encourages feedback from beneficiaries to improve the scheme further. 

This feedback mechanism is essential for making necessary adjustments to the program. 

Overall, the Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana represents a significant effort by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to empower the children of construction workers. 

By addressing educational needs, the scheme aims to break the cycle of poverty and improve the quality of life for these families. 

The initiative reflects a growing recognition of the importance of education as a fundamental right for all children. 

The government remains committed to ensuring that no child is left behind in the pursuit of education. 

This scheme is one of many efforts aimed at enhancing the welfare of workers in the informal sector. 

The government continues to explore additional measures to support the families of construction workers. 

Such initiatives are crucial for fostering a more equitable society. 

The scheme is expected to have a lasting impact on the educational landscape for children of construction workers in Uttar Pradesh. 

By providing necessary resources, the government aims to inspire a new generation of educated individuals. 

This could lead to improved employment opportunities and economic stability for these families in the future. 

In conclusion, the Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana is a vital step towards ensuring that children from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the educational support they need. 

The scheme exemplifies the government's commitment to social welfare and education for all.
